source_files.name: Legends.pdf
source_files.note: Mubarraz Redevelopment Project (EPC Phase) P&ID Legends & Symbols — ADNOC / Abu Dhabi Oil Co. Ltd. DWG: PJ6-EXD-GEN-BQDA-0002 Rev.1. Extracted from 4 legend sheets covering line types, actuator symbols, scope markers, line numbering, equipment numbering, instrument table, valve arrangements (TYPE 1–8), sample point details, LCS arrangements, and level transmitter representations.

equipment_symbols.exchanger_shell_tube: Shell and tube heat exchanger (prefix E)
equipment_symbols.local_control_station: Local Control Station (LCS) — duty or standby configuration

line_types.secondary_process_utility: Secondary process and utility line (thinner solid)
line_types.line_slope: Line to slope down (slope arrow annotation)

scope_symbols.new_scope: New scope — standard solid line boundary (default unless marked otherwise)
scope_symbols.existing_scope: Existing scope — dashed boundary box; items to remain as-is
scope_symbols.demolition_scope: Demolition scope — cross-hatched or specific pattern boundary; items to be removed
scope_symbols.brownfield_scope: Brownfield scope — shaded/filled boundary box; interfaces with existing plant
scope_symbols.revision_cloud: Revision cloud — marks areas changed in current revision

actuator_symbols.diaphragm_actuator: Diaphragm actuator (spring return) — symbol with spring lines
actuator_symbols.motor_actuator: Motor actuator (MOV) — M in circle above valve symbol
actuator_symbols.hand_control: Hand/manual control actuator (HC) — hand symbol or HC tag
actuator_symbols.solenoid_actuator: Solenoid actuator (SOV/SOL) — solenoid coil symbol on valve
actuator_symbols.pneumatic_actuator: Pneumatic actuator — pneumatic signal connection to diaphragm

instrument_symbols.local_indicator: Local indicator (field-mounted, no circle or square bubble)
instrument_symbols.field_transmitter: Field-mounted transmitter (circle with tag, connected to process)
instrument_symbols.sample_point: Sample point (SP) — specific nozzle/valve arrangement, see SAMPLE POINT DETAILS
instrument_symbols.level_transmitter_type_b: Type B level transmitter — flare & drain line connected configuration (see Sheet 004)

valve_symbols.double_block_bleed: Double block and bleed (DBB) valve arrangement

valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_1: Manual valve — single manual isolation valve with no bypass; standard on/off duty
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_2: Actuated valve — actuated (MOV/SDV/SOV) with manual bypass isolation, no control
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_3: Control valve — control valve (FCV/PCV/LCV/TCV) with upstream/downstream isolation and bypass
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_4: Actuated valve with sample point — as TYPE 2 with integrated sample connection
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_5: Control valve with sample point — as TYPE 3 with sample nozzle arrangement
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_6: Safety valve arrangement — PSV/PRV with isolation valve and back-pressure check
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_7: Restriction orifice (RO) spool — with flanged spool piece and isolation valves
valve_arrangement_types.TYPE_8: Meter run / flow measurement arrangement — with isolation, bypass and flow element

signal_types.AI: Analog Input — 4–20 mA signal from field transmitter to DCS/ESD
signal_types.AO: Analog Output — 4–20 mA signal from DCS/ESD to field actuator
signal_types.DI: Digital Input — discrete on/off signal from field device to DCS/ESD
signal_types.DO: Digital Output — discrete on/off command from DCS/ESD to field device
signal_types.FF: Foundation Fieldbus — digital fieldbus protocol (IEC 61158), orange cable with longitudinal blue stripe
signal_types.HART: Highway Addressable Remote Transducer — digital communication superimposed on 4–20 mA

fail_positions.FC: Fail Close — valve closes on loss of signal/power/air
fail_positions.FO: Fail Open — valve opens on loss of signal/power/air
fail_positions.FL: Fail Last — valve stays in last position on loss of signal/power/air
fail_positions.FP: Fail in Place — control element holds last position on failure

cable_types.1P_2.5_DIGITAL_DCS: Single-pair, collective screen, armoured, flame retardant XLPE/Coll Scr/SWA/LSHF — 1P x 2.5 mm² — DCS Digital — BLACK
cable_types.10P_2.5_DIGITAL_DCS: Multi-pair, collective screen, armoured, flame retardant XLPE/Coll Scr/SWA/LSHF — 10P x 2.5 mm² — DCS Digital — BLACK
cable_types.1P_1.5_FF_DCS: Single-pair, foil shield, armoured, flame retardant XLPE/Coll Scr/SWA/LSHF — 1P x 1.5 mm² — Foundation Fieldbus — ORANGE with longitudinal BLUE stripe
cable_types.1T_1.5_ANALOG_FG: Single-triad, collective screen, armoured, fire resistant Mica/XLPE/Coll Scr/SWA/LSHF — 1T x 1.5 mm² — F&G Analog — RED
cable_types.2P_1.5_DIGITAL_DCS: Multi-pair, individual & collective screen, armoured, flame retardant XLPE/Ind & Coll Scr/SWA/LSHF — 2P x 1.5 mm² — DCS Digital — BLUE

abbreviations.LSHF: Low Smoke Halogen Free (cable sheath material)
abbreviations.HART: Highway Addressable Remote Transducer (instrument communication protocol)
abbreviations.LT: Low Temperature (also Level Transmitter in tag context)

mubarraz_format.description: Mubarraz Redevelopment Project (ADNOC / Abu Dhabi Oil Co.) line number format
mubarraz_format.tag_format: [AREA][PP][NNN]-[NNNNN] where AREA=area code, PP=unit prefix, NNN=instrument type, NNNNN=sequential number
